name: test_run
description: Run an explicitly discovered changed-scope local test plan for legacy workflows.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repository. Required whenever discoveryOutcome is 'discovered' (verification actually runs); missing repos surface as an infra_blocked result.

candidateCommit.description: Candidate commit to check out into a disposable worktree and verify. Blank is treated as missing and yields a blocked result.

discoveryOutcome.description: Outcome carried in from test_discover: 'no_tests_required' short-circuits to a passed result, 'discovered' proceeds to run commands, anything else is treated as blocked using discoveryReason.

discoveryReason.description: Reason to report when discoveryOutcome is neither 'discovered' nor 'no_tests_required'.

commands.description: Non-empty list of discovered command objects to run (each with an argv array and coverage evidence). Required when discoveryOutcome is 'discovered'.

testMode.description: 'targeted' verifies changed scope only; 'full' verifies the whole repository. Defaults to 'targeted'.

allowHeavySuites.description: Opts into heavy/expensive suites. Only takes effect when testMode is 'full'.

verificationState.description: 'passed' when every command exited 0, 'failed' when a command exited non-zero, 'blocked' when execution could not proceed at all.

executionOutcome.description: Fine-grained execution outcome; 'configuration_blocked' comes from a documented VerificationBlocked reason, 'infra_blocked' from an unexpected execution error.

candidateCommit.description: The candidate commit that was verified (the actual resolved SHA on a real run).

commands.description: Per-command execution results. Empty when blocked or when no tests are required.

argv.description: The exact argv that was executed.

source.description: Where this command came from (e.g. provided, agent-proposal, repository-config:*).

exitCode.description: Process exit code; 127 denotes a blocked/unspawnable command.

javaVersion.description: Resolved Java version, when the command's entrypoint requires one.

scope.description: Coverage scope of this command, e.g. focused or affected.

affectedUnit.description: The build/test unit this command targets.

dependencyCache.description: Path to the isolated dependency cache used for this run.

runtime.description: Runtime availability evidence collected before execution.

blocked.description: True when this command could not run due to a runtime or spawn problem.

logPath.description: Path to the full captured stdout/stderr log for this command.

coverage.description: Overall coverage character of the commands that ran, e.g. focused, affected, not-applicable.

affectedUnits.description: Build/test units the executed commands affect.

reason.description: Present only when blocked or when no tests are required: a human-readable explanation.

runtimeRequirements.description: Present on a real run: detected runtime/tooling requirements used during execution.

artifactDir.description: Present on a real run: directory holding per-command logs for this candidate.

projectRelativePath.description: Present on a real run: path of the project within the git root, relative to the git root.

worktreeIsDisposable.description: Present on a real run: always true, confirming the run executed in a disposable checkout.

gitMetadataIsIsolated.description: Present on a real run: always true, confirming git metadata was isolated from the source repo.

sourceRemoteDetached.description: Present on a real run: always true, confirming the origin remote was removed before running candidate code.

testMode.description: Present on a real run: the resolved test mode used.
